title: Generalization Can Emerge in Tabular Foundation Models From a Single Table
abstract: arXiv:2511.09665v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep tabular modelling increasingly relies on in-context learning where, during inference, a model receives a set of $(x,y)$ pairs as context and predicts labels for new inputs without weight updates. We challenge the prevailing view that broad generalization here requires pre-training on large synthetic corpora (e.g., TabPFN priors) or a large collection of real data (e.g., TabDPT training datasets), discovering that a relatively small amount of data suffices for generalization. We find that simple self-supervised pre-training on just a \emph{single} real table can produce surprisingly strong transfer across heterogeneous benchmarks. By systematically pre-training and evaluating on many diverse datasets, we analyze what aspects of the data are most important for building a Tabular Foundation Model (TFM) generalizing across domains. translated_title: 表格基础模型的泛化能力可以从单张表格中涌现
translated_abstract: 深度表格建模日益依赖于上下文学习，即在推理过程中，模型接收一组 $(x,y)$ 对作为上下文，并在不更新权重的情况下为新输入预测标签。我们挑战了当前的主流观点——即广泛的泛化能力需要在大型合成语料库（如 TabPFN 先验）或大量真实数据集合（如 TabDPT 训练数据集）上进行预训练——并发现相对少量的数据就足以实现泛化。我们发现，仅在单张真实表格上进行简单的自监督预训练，就能产生惊人强大的跨异构基准迁移能力。通过在众多不同的数据集上进行系统的预训练与评估，我们分析了数据的哪些方面对于构建能够跨领域泛化的表格基础模型（TFM）最为重要。随后，我们将其与大多数表格基础模型所共享的预训练流程联系起来，并展示了数量和质量……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 研究发现表格基础模型无需依赖大规模合成语料或海量真实数据，仅在单张真实表格上进行自监督预训练，就能涌现出跨领域的强大泛化能力。
en_tdlr: Tabular foundation models can achieve surprisingly strong cross-domain generalization through simple self-supervised pre-training on just a single real table, without requiring large synthetic corpora or massive real-world datasets.
